meta.description: EXAMPLE net-worth actuals — fictional. Copy to data/accounts.json. Use source "manual" until Monarch mapping is set up. Owner keys kevin/hanna are fixed by the app (Person A / Person B); put real people in those slots.
meta.reconciliationNotes: Filled during first-time setup. Leave mapping.accounts empty until Monarch is linked.

kevin.note: Person A's share of home equity (or full amount on one side and 0 on the other).

hanna.note: Person B's share of home equity.

mapping.notes: Monarch get_accounts numeric id → balance field. Leave accounts empty for manual-only setup. Example target paths: balances.brokerage.kevin or balances.cash.kevin.components.Ally Savings (if you add a components array).
